description: Entur journey planner — plan a public-transport trip between any two places in Norway (Oslo to Bergen train, airport connections, city tram/metro/bus routes, ferries). Returns door-to-door itineraries with legs (mode, line, operator like Vy or Flytoget, aimed and expected times), total duration, transfer count, and walking distance. Example: entur_journey({ from: "Oslo S", to: "Bergen stasjon" })

depart_at.description: Optional departure time, ISO 8601 (e.g. "2026-07-20T08:00:00+02:00"). Default: now.

from.description: Origin — place/station name or NSR id, e.g. "Oslo S"

modes.description: Optional: restrict transit legs to these modes, e.g. ["rail"] for train-only

to.description: Destination — place/station name or NSR id, e.g. "Bergen stasjon"

name: entur_journey
